description: CONSTRUCTED for issue #2796 finding 3 (the checklist block overlapping the findings), from person-quality-hole-detail: same four-fact profile and the same two COMPLETENESS/VERIFIABILITY issues, plus two CONSISTENCY DATE_MISMATCH issues rendered from that issueType's template in person-quality-templates.ts. Each one restates a finding the audit makes from the records: the death-date mismatch against the Minnesota Death Index is the index-error finding (1954 indexed, 1945 on the profile), and the birth-date mismatch against the 1885 state census is one field of the misattribution finding. Printed verbatim under 'suggestions, not errors', the first would call the index error a suggestion and the second would reopen a source the audit has already assigned to KD96-WX7. No other fixture carries a CONSISTENCY or COHERENCE issue.
